title: Ampere force magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly states the magnetic force on the coil as F = NBIl.

title: Hooke's Law application
description: Essential: Applies F = kΔx to find the spring extension Δx = NBIl/k.

title: Mirror rotation angle
description: Important: Relates spring extension to mirror tilt via geometry: Δx = dθ (small angle).

title: Spot displacement relation
description: Important: Correctly relates mirror tilt to light spot arc length: s = r*(2θ) = 2rθ.

title: Final arc length formula
description: Essential: Combines steps to derive final answer for part (2): s = (2NBIlr)/(dk).

title: Superposition setup
description: Important: Sets up equations for s1 and s2 including an initial offset s' due to improper zeroing.

title: Simultaneous equation solution
description: Essential: Solves the system to eliminate s' and find I' = dk(s1+s2)/(4NBlr).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Misapplies sign for force, extension, or rotation direction in parts (1) or (3).

title: Factor of two omission
description: Pitfall: Forgets the factor of 2 in the reflected light angle (s = rθ instead of s = 2rθ).

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Verifies dimensional consistency of final expressions (e.g., s in meters).
